provider_attempts.disposition: Operationally incomplete after repeated explicit unbilled HTTP 429 sequences persisted across a cooldown.
Rejected before inference: the endpoint could not satisfy the required strict JSON-schema parameters with require_parameters enabled.
Operationally incomplete after the endpoint stopped accepting new requests despite cooldown and request pacing.

common_target_comparison.method: Intersect the repeat-one document and target identities captured by both DeepSeek V4 Pro providers, then score the existing DeepSeek V4 Flash and GPT-5.6 Sol repeat-one outputs on exactly the same target identities. Aggregate word-error counts are micro totals over this fixed intersection.

semantic_review.scope: All three numerically regressed DeepInfra FP4 targets among the 47 captured requests.

cases.rationale: The model repairs several obvious recognizer errors but changes a plural construction to singular and reconstructs one damaged commercial-audiobook phrase less faithfully than the reference.
The model turns a severely garbled dialogue fragment into the unsupported statement “L’IA, qu’est-ce que c’est ?”, adding content absent from the source.
The model mostly adds dialogue punctuation but moves an inferred discourse marker across the speaker attribution, slightly changing the dialogue structure.

decision.rationale: On the fair 41-target intersection, DeepSeek V4 Pro is only 1.2 to 2.2 percentage points better than DeepSeek V4 Flash in relative word-error reduction and remains far behind GPT-5.6 Sol. Its regression count is similar rather than decisively lower, and one selected-provider regression is materially hallucinatory.
decision.hosted_disposition: Retain DeepSeek V4 Flash as the primary value candidate and GPT-5.6 Sol as the quality ceiling. Re-run V4 Pro only when one pinned structured-output ZDR route can complete the frozen two-repeat contract reliably.
decision.local_disposition: The hosted V4 Pro result is not local evidence. Continue with the separately pinned larger local MLX screen.

limitations: Neither V4 Pro provider completed the precommitted 60-request first repeat, so this artifact is a paired partial diagnostic rather than a promotion decision.
The provider comparison also changes hosted quantization and serving implementation; it does not isolate model weights alone.
The common-target slice is selected synthetic development evidence and is too small for a robust claim that V4 Pro produces fewer regressions than V4 Flash.
The semantic review is post-hoc and covers only the selected DeepInfra FP4 regressions.
